text:
jamie: Canary run for v2.3.1 finished — posting perf summary. Need quick eyes for perf gate before we open progressive rollout. Dashboard: https://dash.reed.infra/canary/1845123456

canary-bot: Canary summary — baseline vs canary:
- p95 latency: baseline 95ms -> canary 118ms (+24%)
- p99 latency: baseline 310ms -> canary 420ms (+35%) <-- flagged
- error rate: baseline 0.2% -> canary 0.5%
- throughput (RPS): baseline 140 -> canary 132
- GPU mem high-water: node-7 86%
Auto-fallback not triggered. Perf-gate: FAIL (p99 > +20%).

priya: hmm p99 spike is annoying. Do we have the trace profiles and which op is hot? can you attach perf flame or a perf trace?

marc: i pulled the flame quickly — looks like attention kernel times up ~2.6x for long sequences in canary. suspect more long-context test cases made it into the canary traffic.

jamie: marc - can you run a targeted micro-bench for seq_len 2048 vs 1024 and post the numbers? if attention kernel is regressing we need a mitigation before rollout.

marc: will run now, ETA 12m. also checking if quantization fallback changed kernel selection.

dan: until we triage, put a hold on progressive rollout. if we need to revert, rollback command is:
```
./deploy rollback --env prod --release v2.3.1 --force 
# will pin traffic to v2.3.0 and disable progressive window
```
please confirm you have the rollback plan and DB compatibility check.

sasha: +1 hold. also can we route a small % (10%) to a smaller model variant (v2.2-quant) as an intermediate mitigation? that would buy time while we profile.

infra-oncall: FYI node-7 had a short GC/oom-like pressure spike during the run — logs: https://logs.reed.infra/node-7/1845123456. not full OOM but memory reclamation correlated with tail latency. scaling would help but doesn't address kernel perf regression.

priya: i want the callstack traces from the profiling agent and the perf bench run before we decide to revert. if marc's micro-bench shows the same delta we should prefer an immediate fallback to v2.2-quant for 20% and keep the canary isolated.

deploy-bot: Progressive rollout currently paused by jamie at 1845123480. Current traffic: canary 5% -> paused. Deploy link: https://deploy.reed.infra/releases/v2.3.1

marc: micro-bench results: seq=1024 p99 ~ 320ms, seq=2048 p99 ~ 610ms on canary build; baseline for seq=2048 was ~450ms. so attention kernel scales worse on canary. attaching short CSV to dashboard.

jamie: thanks. decision checklist: 1) pause rollout — done. 2) enable fallback routing to v2.2-quant @10% — need thumbs. 3) run deeper profiler / bisect kernel change — marc. 4) rollback plan ready if mitigation fails.

sasha: :thumbsup: on 10% fallback. need monitoring on correctness diffs (samples) as well.

dan: approved for immediate 10% fallback and keep rollback command ready. i'll prepare a one-click rollback incantation for on-call.

priya: ok i have profiler trace scheduled and will upload in ~20m. if we see a single offending kernel change we can cherry-pick revert instead of full rollback.

jamie: consensus: hold + 10% fallback to v2.2-quant + triage. i'll mark the canary as held and update the release ticket. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
